SF: previous solve reported success; plant integration crosses the boundary at 4.7 s. The next 20 guard steps apply zero input, then the trial fails.
Points are actual 0.1 s records; lines only connect samples. Negative clearance means map-boundary intrusion; zero means obstacle contact/overlap. No continuous-time guarantee.
